chunks: Al-Ḥusayn ibn Muḥammad, from Muʿallā ibn Muḥammad, from ʿAbdullāh ibn Idrīs, from Muḥammad ibn Sinān, from al-Riḍā عليه السلام, regarding His saying:
Allah, Mighty and Majestic: “Grievous to the polytheists is that to which you call them, O Muḥammad صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم — of the wilayah of ʿAlī عليه السلام.”
Thus it is written in the book.

key_terms.الْكِتَابِ: the book; the written text being referred to in the report
key_terms.الْمُشْرِكِينَ: the polytheists; those upon whom this call is described as grievous
key_terms.عَلِيٍّ: ʿAlī; Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام, whose wilayah is being referenced
key_terms.مَخْطُوطَةٌ: written down; recorded in written form
key_terms.وَلَايَةِ: wilayah; divinely mandated authority and guardianship

ai.seo_question: How is Qur'an 42:13 interpreted in Shia hadith regarding the wilayah of ʿAlī عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This report presents a quranic commentary from al-Riḍā عليه السلام on the verse about what is burdensome to the polytheists, interpreting it in connection with the wilayah of ʿAlī عليه السلام. It highlights the significance of wilayah as a central revealed matter and frames the verse within the doctrine of divinely appointed authority.
